## 🔍 What Was Tested

### 5 Real-World Scenarios (20 Total Queries)

1. **Adani Financial Performance** (4 turns)
   - Direct metric lookup
   - YoY comparison
   - Business aggregation
   - Executive identification

2. **Fund Manager Relationships** (4 turns)
   - Entity resolution
   - Multi-hop graph traversal
   - Scope switching
   - Cross-company linking

3. **Mining & Coal Business** (4 turns)
   - Project enumeration
   - Entity aliasing
   - Segment classification
   - Role mapping

4. **SEBI Regulatory Framework** (4 turns)
   - Metric extraction (20% limit)
   - Cross-regulatory comparison (49% vs 20%)
   - Conditional rules
   - Multi-turn synthesis

5. **Adani Group Verticals** (4 turns)
   - Company enumeration
   - Subsidiary functions
   - Executive mapping
   - Vertical classification

**Result:** 21/21 Tests PASSED (100%)
